en: A black-and-white image of a grand European street scene, featuring ornately decorated historic buildings with baroque and neo-renaissance architectural details. There are shop signs, including 'SIMON.' and 'REGENSTOCK.' elegantly dressed people in Edwardian-era clothing stroll along a wide, well-kept promenade. Trees and hills are visible in the background, and statues flank the entrance to the prominent building on the left.
